description: Régularité mensuelle Transilien is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ponctualité mensuelle Transilien depuis janvier 2013. Sur Transilien, la qualité de service est évaluée au regard de la "ponctualité voyageurs", c’est-à-dire le pourcentage de voyageurs arrivant avec un retard de moins de cinq minutes à leur gare de destination. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Qualité de service. Its keywords are Régularité, Transilien, Ile-de-France. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
